## Archive and installation

The prebuilt archive targets **Linux x86-64, glibc 2.35 or newer** and contains `hs`, `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, and `completions/`. Matching source archives are attached below; other Linux environments can build from source.

Verify the archive against `SHA256SUMS`, extract it, and install `hs` on your `PATH`. See `README.md` for installation steps, `docs/guide.md` for shell completion setup, and `docs/hamster.md` before importing a Project Hamster database. Keep backups of important history.

Contributions, bug reports, and installation feedback are welcome.
